maya: quick sketch — thinking about enabling a client-side fallback flow when a preferred routing pool returns capacity errors. goal: reduce p99 errors for apps that can tolerate a cheaper/longer route while keeping telemetry so product/ops can measure fallbacks.

maya: rough flow: client sends request with header `x-rw-route-hint: pool=fast`; if we get a 503 or 429 with body `no-capacity`, retry once with `x-rw-route-hint: pool=cheap` and tag telemetry with `route_fallback=cheap` and `fallback_reason=capacity`.

erik: important Q — is this an SDK-only behavior or server-side? we can't change server routing semantics without infra buy-in.

maya: SDK-only for initial rollout. server already returns clear error codes when pool exhausted. we rely on that contract.

jess: prefer opt-in. breaking hidden retry behavior in SDKs is a recipe for surprise. suggest config flag `enableRouteFallback` default false. sample: ```python
# python example
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv('RW_KEY'), enable_route_fallback=True)
```
and TS: ```ts
const c = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY, enableRouteFallback: true })
```

liu: oncall note — retries can cascade. require: jittered backoff, single retry only, and honor quota response headers (x-rw-quota-remaining). Also we should not change default backoff/timeout.

maya: agreed — single immediate retry with small jitter (50-150ms) and no more than 1 retry per request. we'll read `x-rw-quota-remaining` and if < 5 don't retry.

adele: product POV — we need dashboards for this metric before enabling widely. add a console tile that shows fallback rate by org and model. also gating: enable for dedicated customers first.

jess: logging/telemetry detail: include `route_hint` (original), `route_used`, `fallback_count`, `fallback_reason`. make sampling configurable so it doesn't blow up metrics.

maya: proposal for rollout: 1) merge SDK flag behind opt-in devex release, 2) add fallback telemetry event v1, 3) console dashboard query & alert if fallback_rate > 1% and latency increases, 4) enable for 3 dedicated customers as experiment, 5) revisit default after experiment.

erik: compatibility: bump minor semver for SDKs and add clear changelog entry. doc PR should describe header names and exactly when SDK retries.

liu: also add a runtime kill-switch endpoint for oncall to disable SDK retries org-wide if needed. can we expose that in the control plane?

maya: yes — will file infra ticket for control-plane toggle + console switch.

sdk-bot: note: opened ticket RW-5234 for control-plane toggle and RW-5235 for console dashboard.

jess: action items: (1) maya -> draft SDK PR with flag + tests, (2) erik -> changelog snippet + compat note, (3) adele -> dashboard mock, (4) liu -> runbook addition + kill-switch API schema.

maya: I'll start the PR today. tagging @erik @jess @liu @adele for visibility :thumbsup:

erik: thanks — let's keep the opt-in strong and monitor telemetry closely.

jess: lgtm, keep the retry logic tiny.

liu: adding runbook entry after infra ticket lands.

adele: thanks all.
